items.title: TRA: Kaohsiung → Bao'an Station
items.getThere: TRA Kaohsiung Station is a 3–5 min walk from Airline Inn. All four trains are direct 區間 (local) services; no change needed.
highlights: 3152 (08:24→09:20) lands just before Ten Drum's 09:30 Saturday opening.
3146 (07:50→08:52) gives a buffer if you want breakfast near Bao'an.
tips: Local (區間) trains are non-reserved — no seat booking needed.
Child/senior fare on these locals is NT$43.
items.watch: Bao'an is a small station — confirm the train actually stops there (all four listed above do).

items.title: Bao'an Station → Ten Drum (walk or short taxi)
items.getThere: Bao'an Station: 臺南市仁德區文賢路一段529巷10號. Ten Drum: 臺南市仁德區文華路二段326號 (tel 06-2662225).
highlights: Bao'an Station (built 1899, Alishan cypress) is Taiwan's best-preserved Japanese-era wooden station — worth 5 min of photos.
The station is open all year and free to look around.
tips: Ten Drum opens 09:30 on Saturdays, so arriving on the 09:20 train is ideal.
Weekday hours are different (10:00–17:20) — the Saturday times apply on Dec 5.

items.title: Ten Drum Cultural Village
items.hours: Sat 09:30–17:50 (Mon–Fri 10:00–17:20). Drum shows 11:00 and 15:00. Some halls/rides pause 11:45–13:10 for maintenance
items.cost: Adult NT$509 at gate; NT$458 online via Ten Drum's LINE (valid 2026/1/1–12/31, exchange at ticket booth on the day and book a show slot). Extra show NT$300
items.getThere: 臺南市仁德區文華路二段326號 — near TRA Bao'an Station.
highlights: Ticket includes unlimited use of the 'extreme' facilities: Sky Swing (min 120 cm, 25–180 kg), Free Fall and Outdoor Zipline (min 120 cm, 30–110 kg).
Also: Chimney Slide, Transparent Climbing Wall, Outdoor Archery, Pole Rowing, Laser Tag (min 140 cm).
One drum show per ticket (11:00 or 15:00); seats chosen when you exchange the ticket.
tips: Zipline, Sky Swing, Free Fall and Laser Tag open from 13:10 — do archery, chimney slide and climbing wall in the morning.
Wear closed-toe shoes and trousers: high rides need closed-toe shoes and some walkways are see-through.
Lunch during the 11:45–13:10 pause: 十鼓餐廳, 蜜橋咖啡, 修護書屋, 鼓找冰屋 stay open.
items.watch: Single same-day entry — leaving means a new ticket. Sign the extreme-activity consent form. Pole Rowing had November closure dates; check the facility notice for December.

items.title: Taxi into Central Tainan
items.getThere: Cheaper than a taxi: TRA Bao'an→Tainan locals on Dec 5 at 15:37→15:43, 15:48→15:54, 16:08→16:14, 16:13→16:20, 16:33→16:39 (6–7 min). From Tainan Station take a short taxi to the food stop.
highlights: Trains run every 10–20 min in the late afternoon.
The ride is only 6–7 min to Tainan Station.
tips: Ten Drum closes 17:50 on Saturdays; later Bao'an→Tainan locals also run (16:45, 16:54).
Wusheng Night Market opens at 17:00, so there is no need to rush.

items.title: Wusheng Night Market — Food & Games
items.hours: Wed, Fri, Sat 17:00–00:00 (closed Sun–Tue, Thu) — Saturday Dec 5 is an operating night
items.getThere: 臺南市中西區武聖路69巷42號 — the square at 武聖路69巷 × 光賢街.
highlights: Strong on old-school games: ring toss (套圈圈), pinball (打彈珠).
3-star stalls: 陳家阿嬤拔絲地瓜 (candied sweet-potato fries), 古玥茶 (soy-milk black tea, herbal black tea).
tips: Arrive near 17:00 opening to play games before the crowd.
Eat the protein-heavy stalls first, then the rated sweet-potato and tea stalls for dessert.
items.watch: If Wusheng is too crowded, Garden Night Market (北區) also runs on Saturdays (Thu–Sun).

sources.label: Tainan Market Office: 武聖夜市

items.title: Taxi to Tainan Station → TRA to Kaohsiung
items.cost: Tze-Chiang (自強) NT$158; local (區間) NT$102 (adult, one way)
items.getThere: Tainan Station → Kaohsiung Station, then 3–5 min walk to Airline Inn.
highlights: 自強145 (22:29→23:05) fits the 'back ~11:15 PM' target.
Tze-Chiang trains take 30–37 min; locals take ~1 h.
tips: Book a Tze-Chiang seat on the TRA app/site in advance for a Saturday night.
items.watch: Last train is 自強281 at 23:46 (arrives 00:21). Child/senior fares: 自強 NT$79, 區間 NT$51.
